parameters.description: Remove ALL scattered tiny green and brown pixels from the ground. Keep only the TWO main grass clumps. Replace the noisy terrain texture with THREE broad flat connected low-contrast color areas: calm olive-brown earth and two gray-olive moss shapes with no outlines. No granular detail, flecks, stippling or dithering. Preserve tile shape, thin sides, camera, palette mood, and plant positions. Transparent outside. Quiet natural ground, not a patterned carpet.
